```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(jsonlite)

lilly_data <- read_csv("data/lilly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(sex == "F") |>
  arrange(year)

lilly_json <- toJSON(lilly_data)
```

The name **Lilly** slumbered peacefully in the United States throughout the mid-20th century before experiencing a massive awakening around the year 2000. 

Below, Tung Tung Sahur is ready with his *kentongan* (wooden drum). Click **Play** so Tung Tung can strike the plot to wake it up!

```{=html}
<style>
  .tung-container {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff5eb 0%, #fefae0 100%);
    border: 2px solid #e76f51;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.12);
  }
  .tung-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .tung-avatar-wrap {
    position: relative;
    width: 140px;
    height: 140px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .tung-img {
    width: 100%;

    object-fit: cover;

  }
  .tung-hit-anim {
    animation: tungStrike 0.45s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes tungStrike {
    0% { transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(0.98); }

    100% { transform: rotate(-5deg); }
  }
  .hit-burst {
    position: absolute;
    top: -10px;
    right: -25px;
    background: #e76f51;
    color: white;

    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    display: none;
    animation: popBurst 0.3s ease-out;
  }
  @keyframes popBurst {
    0% { transform: scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
    50% { transform: scale(1.3); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  }

    flex-grow: 1;
  }

    background: white;
    border-left: 4px solid #e76f51;

    padding: 10px 16px;

  }

    background: #e76f51;

    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(231, 111, 81, 0.4);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    display: inline-flex;

  }

  }

    width: 100%;

    display: block;

    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;

</style>

<div class="tung-container">
  <div class="tung-header">
    <div class="tung-avatar-wrap">
      <img id="tungImg" class="tung-img" src="tung_tung_sahur.png" alt="Tung Tung Sahur">
      <div id="hitBurst" class="hit-burst">💥 TUNG!</div>
    </div>
    <div class="tung-controls">
      <div id="speechText" class="tung-speech">
        "Tung, tung, tung, tung... Sahur! The plot is fast asleep. Hit Play and I'll strike the drum to wake it up!"
      </div>
      <button id="playBtn" class="play-btn" onclick="startTungAnimation()">
        <span>🥁 Hit Drum & Start Plot</span>
      </button>
      <div id="statusBadge" class="stats-badge">Year: 1926 | Births: 306</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="canvas-wrap">
    <div id="sleepOverlay" class="sleep-overlay">
      <h3>😴 Shhh... The Plot is Asleep</h3>
      <p>Hit the Play button above so Tung Tung can strike the drum!</p>
    </div>
    <canvas id="plotCanvas" width="900" height="420"></canvas>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const rawData = `r lilly_json`;

// Audio synth for wooden kentongan slit drum
function playKentonganBeat(freq = 460) {
  try {
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();

    osc.type = 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(140, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);

    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.7, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.12);

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);

    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.13);
  } catch (e) {}
}

const canvas = document.getElementById('plotCanvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let animIndex = 0;
let isAnimating = false;

function drawBackgroundGrid() {
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;
  const padL = 70, padR = 40, padT = 50, padB = 60;
  
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Y-axis gridlines (0, 1000, 2000, 3000)
  ctx.font = "13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#666666";
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

  const yTicks = [0, 1000, 2000, 3000];
  yTicks.forEach(tick => {
    const y = (h - padB) - (tick / 3200) * (h - padT - padB);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#f0f0f0";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
    ctx.lineTo(w - padR, y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillText(tick.toLocaleString(), padL - 12, y);
  });

  // X-axis ticks (1930, 1945, 1960, 1975, 1990, 2005, 2020)
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  const xTicks = [1930, 1945, 1960, 1975, 1990, 2005, 2020];
  xTicks.forEach(year => {
    const x = padL + ((year - 1926) / (2025 - 1926)) * (w - padL - padR);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#f0f0f0";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, padT);
    ctx.lineTo(x, h - padB);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillText(year, x, h - padB + 10);
  });

  // Titles
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.font = "bold 16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#264653";
  ctx.fillText("Annual US Births Named Lilly (1926–2025)", padL, 25);

  ctx.font = "12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = "#888888";
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Source: US Social Security Administration | Tung Tung Sahur Edition", w - padR, h - 15);
}

function renderUpToIndex(idx) {
  drawBackgroundGrid();

  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;
  const padL = 70, padR = 40, padT = 50, padB = 60;
  const chartW = w - padL - padR;
  const chartH = h - padT - padB;

  if (idx < 0) return;

  const points = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= idx; i++) {
    const d = rawData[i];
    const x = padL + ((d.year - 1926) / (2025 - 1926)) * chartW;
    const y = (h - padB) - (d.count / 3200) * chartH;
    points.push({ x, y, year: d.year, count: d.count });
  }

  // Draw area fill
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, h - padB);
  points.forEach(p => ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y));
  ctx.lineTo(points[points.length - 1].x, h - padB);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.28)";
  ctx.fill();

  // Draw curve line
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);
  points.forEach(p => ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y));
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#e76f51";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Draw current leading point
  const cur = points[points.length - 1];
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cur.x, cur.y, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#e76f51";
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.stroke();
}

drawBackgroundGrid();

function startTungAnimation() {
  if (isAnimating) return;
  isAnimating = true;

  const playBtn = document.getElementById('playBtn');
  const tungImg = document.getElementById('tungImg');
  const burst = document.getElementById('hitBurst');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('sleepOverlay');
  const speech = document.getElementById('speechText');
  const badge = document.getElementById('statusBadge');

  playBtn.disabled = true;
  playBtn.innerHTML = "<span>🥁 Tung Tung Striking!</span>";

  // Hide sleep overlay
  overlay.style.opacity = '0';
  setTimeout(() => { overlay.style.display = 'none'; }, 400);

  // Tung Tung hits the plot!
  tungImg.classList.add('tung-hit-anim');
  burst.style.display = 'block';
  playKentonganBeat(520);
  setTimeout(() => playKentonganBeat(440), 120);

  speech.innerHTML = "<strong>*TUNG! TUNG! TUNG!*</strong> SAHUR! Wake up, plot! Look at Lilly go!";

  animIndex = 0;
  
  const stepInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (animIndex >= rawData.length) {
      clearInterval(stepInterval);
      tungImg.classList.remove('tung-hit-anim');
      burst.style.display = 'none';
      playBtn.disabled = false;
      playBtn.innerHTML = "<span>↺ Hit Again (Replay)</span>";
      speech.innerHTML = "🎉 <strong>Wake up complete!</strong> Lilly peaked at 2,896 births in 2010!";
      isAnimating = false;
      return;
    }

    const curData = rawData[animIndex];
    renderUpToIndex(animIndex);
    badge.innerText = `Year: ${curData.year} | Births: ${curData.count.toLocaleString()}`;

    // Play periodic drum beats during key milestones
    if (curData.year === 1975) {
      playKentonganBeat(380);
      speech.innerHTML = "<em>1975:</em> Lilly is still asleep (only 64 births)... Keep going!";
    } else if (curData.year === 2000) {
      playKentonganBeat(520);
      speech.innerHTML = "🚀 <em>2000:</em> TUNG! Lilly is waking up fast!";
    } else if (curData.year === 2010) {
      playKentonganBeat(600);
      setTimeout(() => playKentonganBeat(520), 100);
      speech.innerHTML = "💥 <em>2010:</em> PEAK LILLY! 2,896 births!";
    } else if (animIndex % 12 === 0) {
      playKentonganBeat(460);
    }

    animIndex++;
  }, 45);
}
</script>
```

### Analysis & Static Reference Plot

The static visualization below was generated using R and `ggplot2`:

```{r}
#| label: plot-popularity
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
ggplot(lilly_data, aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#f4a261", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(color = "#e76f51", linewidth = 1.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1930, 2025, by = 15)) +
  labs(
    title = "Annual US Births Named Lilly (1926–2025)",
    subtitle = "The name slept peacefully for decades before skyrocketing in the 2000s",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Births",
    caption = "Source: US Social Security Administration | Tung Tung Sahur Edition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#264653"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#555555"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
